title: SEC1: Expand RFC 5228/5229 inline documentation for solo maintainer
description:
The codebase references RFC 5228/5229 extensively but lacks inline explanation of key semantic rules. A solo maintainer without Sieve expertise must read the RFC to understand why certain choices were made.

Examples of sparse documentation:
- 'Unknown command — ignore per RFC 5228 §2.9' (evaluator.rs:158) — what does §2.9 say? Why is ignoring fail-safe?
- 'fail-safe' appears twice (evaluator.rs:228, 695) but never defined
- 'Variable names are case-insensitive (RFC 5229 §3)' (evaluator.rs:626) — why? Any other scope rules?
- The  flag (lib.rs:55–68) is set by scanning for require ["variables"], but RFC 5229 §3 interaction is not documented

Acceptance criteria:
- Add brief inline comments (1–2 sentences) explaining:
  - What fail-safe means and why it's correct per the RFC
  - Variable case-insensitivity rule and consequences
  - Why unknown commands are ignored (vs. error)
- Add a top-level comment to evaluator.rs summarizing RFC 5228 vs 5229 scope and key semantic rules (5–10 lines)
